density_breaks.rule: |d log median ticks per hour| > 3.0 x the store-wide median absolute year-over-year change

method.gap_rule: intraday horizons require exactly adjacent bars; the daily horizon accepts 1 to 4 days and drops the Sunday stub bars

payload.note: EDA battery I: per-pair character across five horizons. Evidence and hypotheses only -- no strategy, no backtest, no P&L, no scorecard, and no pair dropped or promoted. Those are the checkpoint's decisions and this card is explicit that they are not its.

R1.bites: the full-history appendix and the density series run on AUDUSD from 2011 and on eleven pairs before it
R1.statement: AUDUSD before 2011-01-01 is excluded from research

windows.why: crossed-quote corruption in two bounded episodes, 2007-04 to 2008-09 and 2009-04 to 2010-10, rejected most of four years and left what survived a biased sample of the window rather than merely a thin one

R3.bites: every spread figure is reported inside a tick-count band; the cross-era band is 3k-10k
R3.statement: spread comparisons across eras must control for ticks per hour

R4.bites: section 6 is that characterisation, and it ends in a verdict rather than a table
R4.statement: tick counts are not a volume or activity proxy until a T4 card has characterised the density series

R7.bites: the appendix era tags come from the by-year agreement table, read from the committed classification
R7.statement: the cross-check class of an hour is density-aware; UNVERIFIABLE means the check could not see it

R8.bites: stated, not applied: R8 is a backtester rule for T7 and this card runs no backtest. Section 7 reports how many unexplained-empty dates the static list names, which is the size of what R8 will remove
R8.statement: the static major-holiday list marks hours ineligible for execution in every backtest
